title: Midnight Moon Origin
description: This mod adds a new origin to minecraft. The Midnight Moon Origin. It centers around stealth and night time. Dependancies are just the original Origin mod.
body:
This mod adds a new origin to Minecraft. It is based on the [Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins) Minecraft mod and requires that as a dependency.It is intended to be a stalking or watching type of origin, one that isnt pvp focused that is mostly just for hanging out with friends or making lore. It is fantastic for servers and is intended for such.

Below are the added features. 

Abilities

Veil of Moonlight — Permanently invisible at night. Crouch during the day to become invisible.

Night Sight — Automatic night vision at night.

Shadow Step — Gain Speed I while invisible.

Silent Step — Mobs detect you at half range while sneaking.

Night Dominion — Strength III at night.

Lunar Drift — Can glide like an elytra at night.

Featherweight — Slow falling activates after falling 10 blocks.

Rotten Feast — Rotten flesh is proper food with no negative effects.

Toxic Gamble — Poisonous potatoes have a 50% chance to grant Regeneration III for 30 seconds.

Fungal Blessing — Mushroom stew grants Regeneration III and Fire Resistance for 30 seconds.

Puffer Luck — Pufferfish is edible and grants max Luck for 5 seconds.

Weaknesses

Fungal Metabolism — Cannot eat normal crops or fruits.

Starved Hunger — Hunger drains 1.5x faster than normal.

Sunlight Sensitivity — Deal 40% less damage when directly exposed to sunlight.

Fire Vulnerability — Take increased damage from fire.

Fragile Body — Fewer max hearts.

No Sleep Overworld — Cannot sleep in the Overworld.

Shadow Bound — Can only wear leather armor.
